method: ITA = arctan((L*-50)/b*) of the mean CIELAB colour of the outer 6-px frame (skin around the lesion), Chardon 1991 categories. Frame pixels darker than RGB sum 150 (dermoscope vignette) are skipped; images with <20 usable pixels excluded. Rough proxy: lighting and camera affect it. Angle computed with atan2(L*−50, b*) on the 64-px images (reproduced by notebooks/12_bias.ipynb). Caveat: 667 of 2,005 frames have b* ≤ 0 (bluish dermoscope lighting), where ITA is not meaningful — the estimate is crude.
